description: 1 x Mature Yew (applicants ref. T1) - Approximately 7.00m: Reduce crown by up to 1.20m, by means of reducing the longest branch tips whilst retaining natural crown structure, and feathering crown line as is practicable. Thin crown density throughout by approximately 1.20-1.40m.  General maintenance.1 x Sycamore Sapling (applicants ref. T2) - Approximately 8.00m: Growing within a hedge within close proximity with other mature developed trees. Fell to ground level.  Inappropriate species for its location.1 x Mature Hawthorn (applicants ref. T3) - Approximately 5.00m:  Reduce Ivy in the lower crown structure by approximately 1.20m-1.40m, closer to the main hedge line (maintain a naturally undulating Ivy mass).  Prune the Rose, hard back into the Hawthorn crown to control spread. Thin crown density by 20%. Reduce over long branches (Tip prune) Hawthorn by up to 1.00m to shape.  General maintenance.Mixed Species Hedge Line (applicants ref. G1) - Consisting primarily of Field Maple, Sycamore, Pyracantha and Hazel:  Reduce Sycamore stems back into the main hedge line at approximately 2.00m. Trim hedge front where formally maintained. Field Maples: Approximately 8.00m:  Reduce crown by approximately 1.20m-1.50m whilst preserving ample furnishing growth to preserve natural growth to preserve natural crown profile.  Thin crown densities by 20-25%.  Remove ivy which may be advancing into main crown structure. Upper hedge Line:  Reduce stems growing into the Field Maples to clear crowns. Reduce over long, wayward stems growing into neighbouring property and between trees by up to 1.80m.  General maintenance/ To tidy and control encroachment.1 x Mature Damson/Plum (applicants ref. T6) - Approximately 5.00m:  A large stem has collapsed onto the fence and should be removed.  Fell leaning stem to ground level. Control hazard.
